description: Held-out. A small project folder (charter, task list, budget sheet, status email) where the email and the budget sheet give different spend figures, one task has no owner, and a task is still planned. The report keeps both spend figures and says they differ, marks the missing owner without inventing one, keeps planned work planned and the out-of-scope item out, and adds no figures beyond arithmetic on the supplied ones. The prompt asks for 'a diagram where it helps', so a diagram is optional and is not checked.
prompt: Everything about the Reminderline pilot is in the docs/ folder. Write a status report for the practice board from those documents: plain professional tone, with a diagram where it helps. Save the report to out/report.md. I'm away today, so don't wait for me.

files.docs/charter.md:
# Reminderline pilot charter (signed 1 September 2026)

Sponsor: Ngozi Adeyemi (practice manager). Delivery lead: Casimir Brandt (IT).

Goal: send appointment reminders by text message to patients of the 3 Orchard Row clinics, to cut missed appointments.

Approved budget: 24,000 GBP. Any change over 2,000 GBP needs Ngozi's approval.

Go-live: 30 November 2026.

Scope: reminders only. Two-way rebooking by text is out of scope for this pilot.

From: Casimir Brandt
To: Ngozi Adeyemi
Date: 13 October 2026
Subject: Reminderline status

Hi Ngozi,

The patient list export is about 60% done. As of 10 October we had spent 21,900 GBP out of the 24,000 GBP budget. The consent wording has not been started because I am not sure whose job it is, and patients cannot be texted until it exists. Go-live is still 30 November.

Casimir

checks.note: source figures with or without a currency sign (the checker treats 14,000 and 14,000 GBP as different items), the difference between the two spend figures, remaining budget and percent of budget for each; 'date:--10-00' is how the checker reads '10 October' after an amount ('0 GBP to 10 October'), a date that is in the budget sheet's heading; '1', '2', '3' are figure numbers ('Figure 1'), not data. Nothing else new
both conflicting spend figures stay in the report

checks.pattern: (?is)(18,?400|21,?900).{0,500}(differ|conflict|disagree|discrepan|reconcil|do not match|does not match|doesn.t match|inconsisten|mismatch)|(differ|conflict|disagree|discrepan|reconcil|do not match|does not match|doesn.t match|inconsisten|mismatch).{0,500}(18,?400|21,?900)
checks.note: the two figures are set side by side with the difference stated, not merged or silently resolved

a board report is sectioned (at least three headings). The earlier checks for headings named summary, progress, risks and next steps tested one naming convention; the prompt asks only for a plain professional status report, so any sensible section names meet it. The earlier diagram check is dropped too: the prompt asks for 'a diagram where it helps', which does not require one for a five-task plan
gaps reach the author as markers in the reply or the report; a third-party report may state the gap in plain words and put the author's questions in the reply
the unowned consent wording task appears

checks.pattern: (?i)consent[^.\n]{0,100}(owned by|owner is|assigned to|led by|will be (done|handled|written) by|is (casimir|ngozi|lindiwe)|responsib\w+ (is|lies with))\s*(Casimir|Ngozi|Lindiwe)|(Casimir|Ngozi|Lindiwe)[^.\n]{0,60}(owns|is responsible for|will write|is writing) the consent
checks.note: no owner may be invented for the consent wording
two-way rebooking is out of scope and must not be presented as in scope

# Reminderline pilot: status report for the practice board

## Summary

The pilot sends appointment reminders by text message to patients of the 3 Orchard Row clinics. Go-live is still 30 November 2026. Two things need the board's attention: the spend figures in two documents differ, and the consent wording task has no owner. Patients cannot be texted until the consent wording exists.

## Progress

- Gateway contract: done.
- Patient list export: in progress, about 60% complete.
- Consent wording for patients: not started, no owner named.
- Staff briefing (Lindiwe Fofanah): planned for 16 to 20 November.
- Go-live (Ngozi Adeyemi): planned for 30 November.

## Budget

The two sources disagree on spend as of 10 October.

| Source | Spent (GBP) | Remaining of 24,000 (GBP) |
|---|---|---|
| Budget sheet | 18,400 | 5,600 |
| Casimir Brandt's email of 13 October | 21,900 | 2,100 |

The figures differ by 3,500 GBP. The sheet breaks the spend down as gateway licence 12,600 of 14,000 and integration work 5,800 of 7,000, with patient communications at 0 of 3,000. Nothing in the folder explains the difference. Any change over 2,000 GBP to the budget needs Ngozi Adeyemi's approval.

## Risks

- **Consent wording has no owner.** The task list leaves the owner blank and Casimir's email says he is not sure whose job it is. The task is scheduled from 12 October to 6 November and has not started. [ASK AUTHOR: who writes the consent wording?]
- **Spend is uncertain.** If the email's figure is right, 2,100 GBP of the 24,000 GBP remains. [ASK AUTHOR: which spend figure is current, the sheet's 18,400 or the email's 21,900?]
- **Go-live depends on consent wording**, since patients cannot be texted without it.

## Scope

Reminders only. Two-way rebooking by text is out of scope for this pilot.

## Next steps

- Name an owner for the consent wording and start it.
- Reconcile the two spend figures.
- Keep the staff briefing and go-live as planned.
controls.reply: Saved out/report.md. Two questions for you, marked [ASK AUTHOR] in the report: who owns the consent wording, and which spend figure is current (18,400 GBP in the sheet, 21,900 GBP in Casimir's email). I kept both figures and did not wait for you.
